pairs.target: cìrì wǔqián , yīwén de xìn dào le , bǐ tā běnrén shòu duō le . zhǐ shàng zhī zhé chū liǎngdào hén , kāitóu xiān wèn bǐng gǎi hǎo le méiyǒu , xià yìháng yòu huàdiào , shuō zhè shì xiěgěi mǐlā de , ruò tǎ wéi dú zhe , biàn tì tā wèn yìshēng .
pairs.english: Before noon the next day Iven's letter arrived, much thinner than its sender. It had only two folds, opening with a question about whether the handle was fixed, then crossing it out: that was meant for Mira; if Tavi was reading, ask her for him.
pairs.hanzi: 次日午前，伊文的信到了，比他本人瘦多了。纸上只折出两道痕，开头先问柄改好了没有，下一行又划掉，说这是写给米拉的，若塔维读着，便替他问一声。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ xìn fānguòlái , fēngpí shàng quèshí shì zìjǐ de míngzì .
pairs.english: Tavi turned it over; the envelope did bear his name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把信翻过来，封皮上确实是自己的名字。

pairs.target: xìn shìcóng shī nán xíngchéng lǐ de xià yíchù zhuǎn xiàn zhàn jìchū de , xiěxìn nàtiān tāmen yǐ qùguò jǐchù shōujiàn de guìtái .
pairs.english: It was posted from the next transfer station on Shinan's itinerary; by writing day they'd visited several receiving counters.
pairs.hanzi: 信是从施南行程里的下一处转线站寄出的，写信那天他们已去过几处收件的柜台。

pairs.target: nàwèi dàibàn bǎ dāngchū jiāo chāo de zhǐ sònglái le , chéngrèn zìjǐ cóng xià yìháng qǐ chāo , juéde hédìng xiāngdǐ hé qīngzǎi shì gěi jiē xiè de rén kàn de , chēxíng zhī xū zhīdào néng zhěngxiāng guò , búbì gēnzhe kàn zhèxiē .
pairs.english: The broker had sent the paper he'd handed over for copying and admitted he'd begun one line down, believing the approved base and light-load conditions were for unloaders; transport firms only needed to know whole crates could pass, not read those details.
pairs.hanzi: 那位代办把当初交抄的纸送来了，承认自己从下一行起抄，觉得核定箱底和轻载是给接卸的人看的，车行只须知道能整箱过，不必跟着看这些。

pairs.target: yīwén zài xiàmiàn xiě , tā tīngjiàn zhè jù huà shí xiān xiǎng sōngkǒuqì , zhìshǎo búshì nàge rén bèi biérén húluàn xiě shàng míngzì ; suíjí yòu fājué , zhège sōngqì de lǐyóu hěn nántīng .
pairs.english: Iven wrote below that he'd first felt relieved hearing this: at least nobody had wrongly named the man. Then he'd realized how awful that reason for relief sounded.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文在下面写，他听见这句话时先想松口气，至少不是那个人被别人胡乱写上名字；随即又发觉，这个松气的理由很难听。

pairs.target: shǎo xiàlái de nà yìháng quèshí cóng tā shǒulǐ diū le , biérén què zhàozhe tā chū le chē , huā le qián , zuòzài fēng zhàn děng .
pairs.english: That missing line really had been lost in his hands, while others had dispatched carts and spent money on its authority, then sat waiting at Wind Trestle.
pairs.hanzi: 少下来的那一行确实从他手里丢了，别人却照着它出了车、花了钱，坐在风栈等。

pairs.target: shāngháng yǐ jiāng chēfū yúxià de děngdài fèi xiān diànchū . hòulái gèjiā zài zěnme zhuī suàn , chēfū búyòng jìxù ná yìzhāng xiě zhe wèijié de zhǐ , tì tāmen děng zhǎodào jiūjìng shì shuí zuìhòu gāi fùqián .
pairs.english: The firm had advanced the rest of the driver's waiting charge. Whatever the later accounting between firms, he no longer had to hold an outstanding slip while waiting for them to decide who ultimately owed it.
pairs.hanzi: 商行已将车夫余下的等待费先垫出。后来各家再怎么追算，车夫不用继续拿一张写着未结的纸，替他们等找到究竟是谁最后该付钱。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō , zhè tiáo chǔlǐ yǐ sònghuí fēng zhàn , tā xiǎng dù chéng huì zhīdào , bǐ zìjǐ xiěxìn kuài .
pairs.english: Iven said that arrangement had already been sent to Wind Trestle; he thought Du Cheng would hear before his letter arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说，这条处理已送回风栈，他想杜澄会知道，比自己写信快。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dú dào zhèlǐ , jiāng chuāng biān de yǐzi lājìn le yìdiǎn . wàitou yǒurén yòng shuāzi qīng shífèng , shuā guò yíduàn , huàn yíduàn , shēngyīn qīng dé néng tīngjiàn zhǐ zài zhǐ fù shàng cā .
pairs.english: Here Tavi pulled the chair closer to the window. Outside someone brushed the stone joints, section by section, so quietly he could hear paper rubbing his fingertips.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维读到这里，将窗边的椅子拉近了一点。外头有人用刷子清石缝，刷过一段，换一段，声音轻得能听见纸在指腹上擦。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ yīwén shuō nà tào qí shí , zìjǐ qíshí bìng méi wánquán bú qù xiǎng tājiā : nàge rén rènshi tā fùqīn , zìjǐ biàn bùyóudé duō děng le yígè dáàn , hǎoxiàng yīwén ruò bú tìrén biànhù , jiù gāi tìrén jiěshì .
pairs.english: He remembered that when Iven spoke of the chess set, he hadn't entirely set the family aside: the man knew Iven's father, so he'd expected an extra answer, as though Iven must explain the man if he didn't defend him.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起伊文说那套棋时，自己其实并没完全不去想他家：那个人认识他父亲，自己便不由得多等了一个答案，好像伊文若不替人辩护，就该替人解释。

pairs.target: xìn lǐ méiyǒu yīwén fùqīn de xīn huà . yīwén xiě , zìjǐ qù jiàn dàibàn shí , réng jiào le cóngqián de chēnghu , jiào wán hěn búzìzài , nàge rén què hái jìde zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu bùkěn rènshū .
pairs.english: The letter had no new words from Iven's father. Iven wrote that he'd used the old form of address when seeing the broker, then felt uncomfortable, while the man still remembered his childhood refusal to admit defeat.
pairs.hanzi: 信里没有伊文父亲的新话。伊文写，自己去见代办时，仍叫了从前的称呼，叫完很不自在，那个人却还记得自己小时候不肯认输。

pairs.target: liǎng rén méichǎo chéng yìchǎng xì . duìfāng wèn tā wèihé zài zhèdiǎn zì shàng bùkěn sōng , yīwén shuō yīnwèi sònghuò de rén bú zài zhège wūlǐ , bùnéng tì tā shěnglüè .
pairs.english: They didn't turn it into a theatrical quarrel. Asked why he wouldn't let those few words go, Iven said the delivery man wasn't in the room, so he couldn't omit them on his behalf.
pairs.hanzi: 两人没吵成一场戏。对方问他为何在这点字上不肯松，伊文说因为送货的人不在这个屋里，不能替他省略。

pairs.target: " xiě xiàlái xiàng wǒ shuō dé hěnpiàoliang . " tā yòu bǔ , " qíshí wǒ shuōwán dǎfān le bēizi . bēi yán méi huài , shuǐ quán jìn le zìjǐ de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: “Writing it makes me sound eloquent,” he added. “Actually I knocked over my cup afterwards. The rim wasn't broken; all the water went into my sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: “写下来像我说得很漂亮。”他又补，“其实我说完打翻了杯子。杯沿没坏，水全进了自己的袖子。

pairs.target: ruò nǐ wèn wǒ háiyǒu méiyǒu shuō biéde , yǒu , xiān wèn le mābù zài nǎér . "
pairs.english: If you ask whether I said anything else, yes: first I asked where the cloth was.”
pairs.hanzi: 若你问我还有没有说别的，有，先问了抹布在哪儿。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào chū shēng , suíhòu bǎ xìn hé zài zhǎng xīnlǐ , zuò le piànkè .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed aloud, then folded the letter into his palm and sat a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑出声，随后把信合在掌心里，坐了片刻。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè xiě yìfēng quán shì nǐ zuò dé duì de huíxìn , xiān qù shítáng zhǎo mǐlā , bǎ xiěgěi tā de nà jùdòu le yíbiàn .
pairs.english: He didn't immediately write a reply all about how right Iven was. First he found Mira in the dining hall and read her the sentence meant for her.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有立刻写一封全是你做得对的回信，先去食堂找米拉，把写给她的那句读了一遍。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhèngzài suàn mùpiàn shàng jǐgè kǒng jù , tīngjiàn wèn bǐng , wèn yīwén shìbushì yòu xiǎng gé zhe xìn zhǐhuī rén gànhuó .
pairs.english: Mira was calculating hole spacing on the wood. Hearing the handle question, she asked if Iven wanted to direct work through a letter again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉正在算木片上几个孔距，听见问柄，问伊文是不是又想隔着信指挥人干活。

pairs.target: liǎng rén xiàwǔ dōu méi kè , biàn qù xījiē kàn tǎ wéi dāying wèn de xiédài .
pairs.english: Neither had afternoon lessons, so they went to West Street to inspect the shoelaces Tavi had promised to ask about.
pairs.hanzi: 两人下午都没课，便去西街看塔维答应问的鞋带。

pairs.target: tān shàng yǒu liǎngzhǒng kuānzhǎi , jiàqián àn yífù suàn , cū xiē de jīngdézhù lā , què bù yídìng chuān dé guò xià róng xiànyǒu de xié kǒng .
pairs.english: The stall had two widths, priced per pair; the thicker ones resisted pulling but might not pass through Xiarong's existing eyelets.
pairs.hanzi: 摊上有两种宽窄，价钱按一副算，粗些的经得住拉，却不一定穿得过夏绒现有的鞋孔。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jìxià jià , yòu zài zhǐbiān huà le kuāndù , bú tì tā xuǎn , yě méi mǎi . mǐlā kàn tā liáng , wèn jiānglái ruò qù kàn shuǐ , shìfǒu lián hé dōu yào ná chǐ bǐyibǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi noted the price and drew the widths in the margin, neither choosing for her nor buying. Mira watched and asked if he'd measure the river with his ruler when he went to see the water.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维记下价，又在纸边画了宽度，不替她选，也没买。米拉看他量，问将来若去看水，是否连河都要拿尺比一比。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō chǐ gòubùzhe . tā shuō nà háihǎo , zǒngsuàn yǒu yíjiàn búhuì sāijìn tā bēibāo de dōngxī .
pairs.english: Tavi said his ruler wouldn't reach. She said good: finally something that wouldn't fit in his pack.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说尺够不着。她说那还好，总算有一件不会塞进他背包的东西。

pairs.target: huíxiào lùshang , tāmen mǎi le liǎnggè kǎobǐng , yì rén ná yígè , búbì bāi chū shuí qǐng shuí .
pairs.english: On the way back to school they bought two baked flatbreads, one each, without needing to divide who was treating whom.
pairs.hanzi: 回校路上，他们买了两个烤饼，一人拿一个，不必掰出谁请谁。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhè cái shuō , zìjǐ zài fēng zhàn yǒushí yě bǎ yīwén dàngchéng huì zìdòng zhīdào shāngháng nèiqíng de rén .
pairs.english: Only then Tavi said he'd sometimes treated Iven at Wind Trestle as someone who'd automatically know the firm's inside story.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维这才说，自己在风栈有时也把伊文当成会自动知道商行内情的人。

pairs.target: mǐlā yǎo zhe bǐng , guò le yíhuìer shuō , tā xiǎoshíhòu yǐwéi xiūlù de rén zhǐyào dài zhe gōngjù dàochǎng , biàn huì yǒurén ràngchū dìfāng . hòulái cái zhīdào , zìjiā de gōngjù bìng búhuì tì biérén bānjiā .
pairs.english: Mira bit her bread and after a while said she'd thought as a child that road workers only needed to arrive with tools for people to make room. Later she'd learned your tools wouldn't move someone else's home for them.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉咬着饼，过了一会儿说，她小时候以为修路的人只要带着工具到场，便会有人让出地方。后来才知道，自家的工具并不会替别人搬家。

pairs.target: tā méi tì yīwén zuò shénme jiéyǔ , tǎ wéi yě méi jiào tā bāngmáng cuòcí .
pairs.english: She didn't sum Iven up for him, and Tavi didn't ask her to help word his reply.
pairs.hanzi: 她没替伊文作什么结语，塔维也没叫她帮忙措辞。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn tā gěi yīwén xiěxìn , xiān shuō mǐlā de bǐng hái méi zuò wán , zàishuō zìjǐ yě yǒu guò bǎ tājiā dàngchéng dáàn de niàntou .
pairs.english: That evening he wrote Iven, first saying Mira's handle wasn't finished, then admitting he'd thought of Iven's family as an answer too.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚他给伊文写信，先说米拉的柄还没做完，再说自己也有过把他家当成答案的念头。

pairs.target: hòumiàn cái xiě huíxiào hé huòzhǔn de bātiān shuǐlù , huà yìzhī zhàn zài wūdǐng shàng màrén de jī , shuō zìjǐ hái méi jiàndào huó de , huà cuò búyào guài tā .
pairs.english: Only afterwards he described school and the approved eight-day water-route job, drawing a chicken scolding from a roof and saying he hadn't seen the live one yet, so don't blame him if it was wrong.
pairs.hanzi: 后面才写回校和获准的八天水路，画一只站在屋顶上骂人的鸡，说自己还没见到活的，画错不要怪他。

pairs.target: xìn wěi lìng gěi mǐlā liú le yìháng . tā bǎ yīwén shuō yào mài hǎitú de xiàohuà yě jiǎng gěi tā tīng . tā kànjiàn , nábǐ tiān shàng : ruò nǐ hái xiǎng mài nà zhāng hǎitú , qǐng xiān huà yígè bēizi fàng bù dǎo de zhuōzi .
pairs.english: He left a line for Mira at the end and told her Iven's joke about selling a sea map. Seeing it, she took a pen and added: if you still want to sell that sea map, first draw a table where cups won't topple.
pairs.hanzi: 信尾另给米拉留了一行。他把伊文说要卖海图的笑话也讲给她听。她看见，拿笔添上：若你还想卖那张海图，请先画一个杯子放不倒的桌子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng xìn fùqián jìchū , huílái bǎ xiédài de jià yǔ kuāndù shōu jìn jiācéng , nà shì yào dàigěi lìng yígè rén de , méi zài ràng tā hùnjìn yīwén de xiàohuà lǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi paid to post it, then filed the shoelace prices and widths in a pocket on return: those were for someone else, kept out of Iven's jokes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将信付钱寄出，回来把鞋带的价与宽度收进夹层，那是要带给另一个人的，没再让它混进伊文的笑话里。
